0c1e924baae3ecbc5fa96e88a1afd0d7d55e8b97.summary: Aqua Team Nautilus analysed eight malicious container images in the Docker Hub account hildeteamtnt, which the report says TeamTNT used. The images carried cryptominers, Tsunami and Mirai, backdoors and Docker escape tools, and at least two were used in attacks. The report calls it a still-active campaign against cloud native environments and misconfigured Docker API ports, and says the newer images use more defence evasion. Published 2020-08-25.
